title: Task register document
description: Front matter of `.ai/TASKS.md`, the register itself. The tasks inside it are not this schema's business: each one is `task.schema.json`, either as a standalone file or as an inline entity block under a level-2 heading. The register's current phase and current task are deliberately absent here, because they are stated in the document body and duplicating them in front matter would give `status` two sources to disagree about.
